question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**mighty**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given blank refers to the attribute of being strong enough to uphold or bear something significant.
 
• The term '**mighty**' means possessing great and impressive power or strength, especially on account of size. (शक्तिशाली)
 
 
• **Example**: The **mighty **warrior defended his kingdom with valor.
 
 
 
• '**Mighty**', in this context, symbolizes the strength required to bear the weight of responsibility, making it the most suitable word to describe the capability of the youth in lifting the nation's responsibility. (शक्तिशाली)
 
• Hence, the correct choice is **mighty**.

Therefore, the correct answer is “**Option 2**”.

 

Complete Passage: *Children are the future of any country and a country that does not take care of this valuable__ resource suffers later. A successful nation is that which makes its youth strong enough to lift this **__mighty__** responsibility on their shoulders. (3) ________, this is not the case in our country. Education, which is a necessity, is still a (4) ________ here. Poor people (5) ________ to send their children to school.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Impotent **means unable to take effective action; helpless or powerless. It generally refers to a lack of power, strength, or vigor. (अशक्त)

 
 
• **Example**: The government seemed **impotent **in the face of the economic crisis.
 
 
 
• **Bulky **refers to something that is taking up much space, typically inconveniently large and awkward. (भारी और बड़ा)
 
 
• **Example**: The **bulky **package was difficult to carry up the stairs.
 
 
 
• **Frail **means physically weak and delicate. It often implies a lack of physical strength due to age or illness. (कमजोर)
 
 
• **Example**: The **frail **old man needed help to walk across the street.
